summary: The team is balancing urgent operational fixes with strategic marketing initiatives, focusing on SEO for Asia Star and Intelligent China, and advancing the China Going-Global report and knowledge website redesign.
summaryDetail: This week, resolve the Outlook login issues affecting team devices and ensure all accounts are secure, as this is disrupting daily operations. Simultaneously, the marketing strategy is prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and content optimization, with drafts for target areas and prompts due from Joseph, and an audit of conversion tracking underway. The China Going-Global report is in its final review stage, with updates to Bin Ma's title and event results pending, and the knowledge website redesign is incorporating editorial-style layouts, with feedback and HTML files being exchanged. Upcoming, the team is preparing for the Bayes Business School collaboration meeting on Sept 11, coordinating attendance, and finalizing speaker invitations for the Tech In Asia event, while also managing approvals for translated articles and press releases.
